slides.title: Create Markers
slides.html:
• When you need to create information on the map and share it with other users, the basic tool for this is Point Dropper.
  • With Point Dropper you can add tactical markings to the map.

slides.title: 2. Markers
slides.html:
• Select markers or icons you want to use
  • By default, tactical icons are what you need

slides.title: 3. Add Marker
slides.html:
• Select a marker you want to use
  • Zoom the map and find the location where you want to add a marker
  • Click on the map to add a marking.

slides.title: Stop Adding Markers
slides.html: • Deselect the icon on the right to stop adding new markings to the map.

slides.title: Edit Marker Details
slides.html:
• To edit an added marker, click the marker
  • Radial Menu opens
  • Select the "Detail" radial submenu

slides.title: Marker Details Menu
slides.html:
• Things to edit
  • Type: Edit type, for example edit to infantry
  • Remarks: Add your own information about the marker / situation
  • Add Attachments
  • Send Marker

slides.title: Edit Marker Type
slides.html:
• You can get into the type editing by clicking the Type field
  • Navigate between different types by using More and the back arrow.

slides.title: Edit Marker Remarks
slides.html: • Click the remark field to add text

slides.title: Add Attachments to a Marker
slides.html:
• Click the paperclip icon to open Attachments
  • Add attachments through the + sign

slides.title: Send Marker
slides.html:
• You can send a marker to:
  • Single user
  • Group
  • Team
  • Data Sync feed

slides.title: Other Functions for a Marker
slides.html:
• Through the radial submenus you can perform the following important actions on a marker:
  • Delete
  • Change location
  • Measure
